reviews.text: I tried to add a gift card to this and kept getting error messages.

reviews.title: Money Grab
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paid Punchbowl subscriber for years, but I finally canceled. Over time, they’ve steadily removed features from my subscription and moved them behind more expensive membership tiers. The latest was the ability to schedule deliveries—a feature I previously had and regularly used.

When I contacted customer support to express my frustration about paying the same while receiving less, their response was essentially instructions on how to cancel my subscription. No attempt to address the concern or retain a longtime customer.

Message received. I canceled. Very disappointing way to treat loyal, paying customers.

reviews.title: Buggy but eventually worked
reviews.text: Often the buttons on pages don’t work, got a spinning wheel of loading when trying to sign up with google. Formatting the design has too few options, for example I could not easily move the invite text to keep it from blending into the background. Had to fix it by making empty text boxes under the text. Also in the app there are no names on the fonts, and it’s a bigger problem than you think it would be. There are dozens of fonts and they are not grouped by type. But there is no way to make sure you’re using the same font on different text boxes unless you COUNT through the line of fonts to match them.
